name: GBP Core Audit
description: Full Google Business Profile audit v1. IMMUTABLE once used — create v2 for changes. Sections: A eligibility/risk, B accuracy, C relevance, D prominence, E content, F conversion, G visibility.

items.check_title: Profile verified and in good standing
items.check_question: Is the profile verified, with no suspension, pending re-verification or warning notices?
items.why_it_matters: An unverified or suspended profile is invisible or at risk regardless of optimisation.
items.review_guidance: Check the GBP dashboard banner area and email notifications for verification or suspension notices.
items.recommended_action: Resolve verification/suspension before any other optimisation work.

items.check_title: Agency has correct access; ownership documented
items.check_question: Do we have manager access, and does the client retain primary ownership on an account they control?
items.why_it_matters: Losing access mid-engagement blocks all work; client-owned profiles avoid disputes.
items.review_guidance: GBP > Business Profile settings > Managers. Record the owner email.
items.recommended_action: Transfer primary ownership to a client-controlled account and keep agency as manager.

items.check_question: Is the profile name the real-world business name without added keywords or locations?
items.why_it_matters: Keyword-stuffed names violate Google policy and are a common suspension trigger.
items.review_guidance: Compare against the website, logo and Companies House/registration name.
items.recommended_action: Plan a compliant rename via an approved sensitive change.

items.check_question: Is this the only listing for this business at this location?
items.why_it_matters: Duplicates split reviews and ranking signals and can trigger suspensions.
items.review_guidance: Search Maps for the name, phone number and address variants.
items.recommended_action: Document duplicates and escalate for merge/removal.

items.check_title: No unexplained pending or Google-suggested edits
items.check_question: Are there pending edits or Google-applied updates we did not initiate?
items.why_it_matters: Google can silently change categories, hours and attributes from third-party suggestions.
items.review_guidance: Look for 'Google updates' badges in the profile editor.
items.recommended_action: Review each pending update; accept or dispute, and log a change record.

items.check_question: Do the address and map pin point at the actual premises (or is the address hidden correctly for an SAB)?
items.why_it_matters: A wrong pin sends customers to the wrong place and hurts proximity relevance.
items.review_guidance: Open the listing in Maps satellite view. Service-area businesses must have the address hidden.
items.recommended_action: Correct the pin/address via an approved sensitive change.

items.check_question: Does the listed number connect to the business (test call), and does it match the website?
items.why_it_matters: A dead or wrong number silently loses every call the profile generates.
items.review_guidance: Test-call the number. Compare with the website contact page.
items.recommended_action: Fix the number via an approved change; consider a call-tracking number as primary with the real number as additional.

items.check_title: Website link points to correct page with tracking
items.check_question: Does the website field link to the correct location/service page and carry UTM parameters?
items.why_it_matters: Without UTMs, GBP traffic is invisible in analytics; a homepage link wastes local relevance.
items.review_guidance: Click the live link. Check for utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp or agreed scheme.
items.recommended_action: Replace with tracked location-page URL.

items.check_title: Opening hours and special hours current
items.check_question: Are regular hours correct, and are special hours set for holidays in the next 14 days?
items.why_it_matters: 'Closed now' at the moment of search loses the enquiry; wrong hours earn negative reviews.
items.review_guidance: Confirm hours with the client; check the special-hours screen.
items.recommended_action: Update hours and set special hours.

items.check_question: Do the listed service areas match where the business actually works (max 20 areas)?
items.why_it_matters: Service areas set expectations and influence which searches the profile can appear in.
items.review_guidance: Compare listed areas against the client's actual coverage.
items.recommended_action: Update the service-area list.

items.check_question: Is the description filled (up to 750 chars), accurate, and does it cover core services and areas?
items.why_it_matters: The description supports relevance and conversion; an empty one wastes the field.
items.review_guidance: Check for keyword stuffing, outdated claims, missing services.
items.recommended_action: Draft and approve a new description.

items.check_title: Primary category matches main revenue service
items.check_question: Is the primary category the closest match to the service that makes the business the most money?
items.why_it_matters: Primary category is the single strongest relevance lever on the profile.
items.review_guidance: Compare with what top-3 competitors for the money keyword use.
items.recommended_action: Propose a category change as an approved sensitive change.

items.check_title: Secondary categories cover all real services
items.check_question: Is every significant service represented by an appropriate secondary category, with none irrelevant?
items.why_it_matters: Missing categories exclude the profile from whole query classes; irrelevant ones dilute it.
items.review_guidance: Map each service line to available categories; check competitors.
items.recommended_action: Add/remove secondary categories via approved change.

items.check_question: Is every service the business sells listed under the right category with a description?
items.why_it_matters: Services feed relevance for long-tail queries and show in the profile.
items.review_guidance: Compare the GBP services screen with the website's service pages.
items.recommended_action: Prepare the missing services and descriptions, then update the profile.

items.check_question: Are all applicable attributes (accessibility, payments, amenities, identity) filled in?
items.why_it_matters: Attributes appear in search filters and improve completeness.
items.review_guidance: GBP > Edit profile > More; check each attribute group.
items.recommended_action: Set the missing attributes.

items.check_title: Landing page topically matches the profile
items.check_question: Does the linked page mention the primary category service and the location prominently?
items.why_it_matters: The linked page's relevance feeds the profile's ranking for those terms.
items.review_guidance: Check the page H1, title tag and body for service + location coverage.
items.recommended_action: Brief landing-page content changes.

items.check_question: Is the review count within striking distance of the local top-3 competitors?
items.why_it_matters: Reviews are a stated prominence factor and the main conversion trust signal.
items.review_guidance: Record own count/rating and the top-3 competitors' counts for the money keyword.
items.recommended_action: Launch a review acquisition batch.

items.check_question: Has the profile received new reviews in the last 30 days?
items.why_it_matters: Recency matters; a profile that stopped earning reviews looks dormant.
items.review_guidance: Sort reviews by newest and note the last three dates.
items.recommended_action: Set up a recurring review-request process.

items.check_question: Does every review — positive and negative — have an owner reply?
items.why_it_matters: Google recommends responding; replies signal an active business and recover unhappy customers.
items.review_guidance: Count unanswered reviews; note any unanswered 1-2 star reviews separately.
items.recommended_action: Run a reply sweep and make it recurring.

items.check_question: Do name, address and phone match exactly on the top directories (Yell, Bing Places, Apple Maps, Facebook, key industry sites)?
items.why_it_matters: Inconsistent citations undermine trust in the profile data.
items.review_guidance: Check the top 5-10 citations; log each mismatch.
items.recommended_action: Create a citation-fix task per mismatch.

items.check_title: Owner photos added in the last 90 days
items.check_question: Have owner photos been uploaded in the past 90 days, covering exterior, team and work?
items.why_it_matters: Fresh photos signal an active business and lift engagement.
items.review_guidance: GBP > Photos > By owner, sort newest.
items.recommended_action: Start the monthly photo cycle.

items.check_title: Posts published in the last 30 days
items.check_question: Is there at least one post from the last 30 days, with no expired offers showing?
items.why_it_matters: Posts keep the profile active and give searchers a current reason to choose the business.
items.review_guidance: View the posts section on the public listing.
items.recommended_action: Start the weekly post cycle.

items.check_question: Are all public questions answered by the business, and are core FAQs seeded?
items.why_it_matters: Unanswered questions get answered by strangers — often wrongly.
items.review_guidance: Open the Q&A section on the public listing.
items.recommended_action: Answer outstanding questions and seed FAQs.

items.check_question: On a phone: does the page load fast, show the service and area immediately, and offer tap-to-call and a quote form?
items.why_it_matters: Most GBP clicks are mobile; a weak page wastes every ranking gain.
items.review_guidance: Test on a real phone or emulator; try the phone link and the form.
items.recommended_action: Brief landing-page fixes to the web team.

items.check_question: Can we tell which calls/enquiries came from the profile (call tracking, UTMs, 'how did you hear')?
items.why_it_matters: Without attribution we cannot prove the work generates leads and revenue.
items.review_guidance: Check for call tracking on the GBP number and UTM-tagged links.
items.recommended_action: Set up tracking before major optimisation pushes.

items.check_title: Target keywords and baseline positions recorded
items.check_question: Do we have the agreed target keyword list and current local positions recorded for this location?
items.why_it_matters: Without a baseline, no improvement can ever be demonstrated.
items.review_guidance: Record positions from the rank tracker or manual incognito checks; store in the audit notes/metrics.
items.recommended_action: Record the keyword baseline before changes begin.

items.check_question: Have we reviewed which queries actually surfaced the profile last month, and do they match the target services?
items.why_it_matters: Reveals mismatches between what the business sells and what it ranks for.
items.review_guidance: GBP > Performance > Searches; compare against the service list.
items.recommended_action: Feed gaps into category/service/content plans.
